svg.title: AI AI Captain: Nocturne complete icon and state combinations
svg.desc: Eleven client/host combinations across ten state and brightness examples: STARTING, WORKING, WAITING bright/dim, DONE fresh/dim/aged/assessed, FAILED and UNK. Claude Desktop, fixed controls and seven 72-pixel samples are included. Assessed DONE is darkest and double-checked but visit detection is not implemented. Choose the live palette in the dashboard.

g.text: Copilot using Claude still uses Copilot goggles.
Codex in JetBrains AI uses brackets + the IJ badge.
Assessed DONE stops blinking immediately; unassessed DONE keeps its ten-minute fade. Frames shown are static.

g.text: Darker than aged DONE, with a double check.
A new turn clears assessment. App focus alone cannot assess all sessions.
Selected brand marks: Lobe Icons 1.100.0. Interface symbols: Lucide 0.468.0. Local assets; licenses accompany these previews.
DESIGN REFERENCE · Assessed DONE detection remains unimplemented · Illustrated products do not imply automatic conversation telemetry.
